title: Open the system metrics pop-up from the Overall System Aveva API page
summary: Use the “Get metrics” control on the Overall System Aveva API page to open a pop-up/metrics page that displays the current system metrics.
when_to_use: When you need to view the current system metrics from the Overall System Aveva API page using the “Get metrics” pop-up.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Open the AVEVA HMI page labeled “Overall System Aveva API”, click “Get metrics”, and confirm the metrics pop-up is visible and populated.
access_or_tools_needed: AVEVA HMI (Overall System Aveva API page)

visual_references.description: Frame showing the Overall System Aveva API page controls including “Get metrics” (and other controls like Reset Metrics / Get errors).

steps.title: Open the AVEVA HMI page labeled “Overall System Aveva API”
steps.purpose: Access the page that contains the “Get metrics” control.
steps.instruction: On the AVEVA HMI, open the page labeled “Overall System Aveva API”.
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System Aveva API” page is displayed with the “Get metrics” control available.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Get metrics” control is visible on the “Overall System Aveva API” page.
steps.failure_condition: The “Overall System Aveva API” page does not load, or the “Get metrics” control is not visible.

actions.label: Open Overall System Aveva API page
actions.exact_action: Open the AVEVA HMI page labeled “Overall System Aveva API”.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Overall System Aveva API page includes controls including “Get metrics”.

steps.title: Click “Get metrics” to open the system metrics pop-up
steps.purpose: Trigger the pop-up that shows all system metrics.
steps.instruction: On the “Overall System Aveva API” page, click the control labeled “Get metrics”.
steps.expected_result: A “Get metrics” pop-up/metrics page opens and displays the system metrics.
steps.healthy_condition: The metrics pop-up/page appears and is populated with system metrics.
steps.failure_condition: Clicking “Get metrics” does not open the pop-up, or the metrics pop-up does not populate.
stop_or_escalate_if: If clicking “Get metrics” does not open the pop-up or the metrics do not populate, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Get metrics gets all the system metrics, pops it up.”

steps.title: Confirm the metrics pop-up is visible and populated
steps.purpose: Ensure the metrics view is ready for use.
steps.instruction: Wait for the “Get metrics” pop-up/metrics page to appear and confirm it contains the system metrics.
steps.expected_result: The metrics pop-up/page is visible and populated.
steps.healthy_condition: The metrics pop-up/page is open and shows the system metrics (described as “all the system metrics”).
steps.failure_condition: The pop-up is visible but empty/unpopulated, or the metrics content is missing.

actions.label: Verify metrics pop-up populated
actions.exact_action: Verify a pop-up/metrics page appears that contains “all the system metrics”.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the metrics pop-up is not populated, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Get metrics gets all the system metrics, pops it up.

success_criteria: A “Get metrics” pop-up/metrics page opens from the “Overall System Aveva API” page.
The metrics pop-up/page is visible and populated with system metrics.
healthy_conditions: On the “Overall System Aveva API” page, “Get metrics” is available.
After clicking “Get metrics”, the metrics pop-up/page appears and is populated with system metrics.
failure_conditions: Clicking “Get metrics” does not open the pop-up.
The metrics pop-up opens but does not populate with system metrics.
escalation_guidance: If clicking “Get metrics” does not open the pop-up or the metrics do not populate, stop and escalate to support.
